entities.summary: Swami Pranavananda also known as Yugācāryya Śrīmat Svāmī Praṇavānanda Jī Mahārāja, was a Hindu yogi and saint who founded a not-for-profit spiritual organization known as the Bharat Sevashram Sangha.
